SELECT COUNT(*) over() AS cnt, rpt_Day, rpt_no, exp_firm, buy_firm, Exp_Lis_Day, Ta_St_isoNm, ran_no, sil, hs, caseType, gnm1, qty, importer, used_qty, remains_qty FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN a.Rpt_Day != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(a.Rpt_Day, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS rpt_Day, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(a.rpt_no, 1, 5), '-', SUBSTRING(a.rpt_no, 6, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(a.rpt_no, 8, 7)) AS rpt_no, a.exp_firm, a.buy_firm, CASE WHEN a.Exp_Lis_Day != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(a.Exp_Lis_Day, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS Exp_Lis_Day, a.Ta_St_isoNm, b.ran_no, c.Sil, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(b.hs, 1, 4), '.', SUBSTRING(b.hs, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(b.hs, 7, 4)) AS hs, CASE WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'RETURNABLE %' THEN REPLACE(gnm1, 'RETURNABLE ', '') WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'PLASTIC BOX (RETURN CARGO, PACKING GOODS)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'PLASTIC BOX (RETURN NCARGO, PACKING GOODS)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'PLASTIC BOX (RETURN CARCO, PACKING GOODS)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'PLASTIC BOX(RETURN CARGO, PACKING GOODS)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE ' PLASTIC BOX(RETURN CARGO, PACKING GOODS)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE ' PLASTIC BOX (RETURN CARGO, PACKING GOODS)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'PLASTIC BOX(RETURN)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'PLASTIC BOX (RETURN CARGO)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE ' PLASTIC BOX (RETURN CARGO)%' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'PLASTIC BOX(RETURN CARGO) %' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'PLASTIC BOX (RETURN CARGO) %' THEN 'PLASTIC BOX' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'IRON CARRIER (RETURN)%' THEN 'IRON CARRIER (RETURN)' WHEN gnm1 LIKE 'IRON CARRIER(RETURN)%' THEN 'IRON CARRIER (RETURN)' WHEN gnm1 LIKE ' IRON CARRIER (RETURN)%' THEN 'IRON CARRIER (RETURN)' ELSE gnm1 END AS caseType, c.Gnm1, FORMAT(c.qty, 0) AS qty, r.importer, FORMAT(SUM(r.used_qty), 0) AS used_qty, FORMAT(c.qty - COALESCE(SUM(r.used_qty), 0), 0) AS remains_qty FROM platform.cusdec830a1 a LEFT JOIN platform.cusdec830b1 b ON a.rpt_no = b.rpt_no AND a.SN = b.SNA1 LEFT JOIN platform.cusdec830c1 c ON a.rpt_no = c.rpt_no AND a.SN = c.SNA1 AND b.SN = c.SNB1 LEFT JOIN remains_info r ON a.rpt_no = r.rpt_no AND b.ran_no = r.lan_no AND c.sil = r.sil WHERE a.rpt_seq = '00' AND b.hs IN ('3923100000', '7310290000', '3923900000') AND c.gnm1 IS NOT NULL AND (a.Exp_Lis_Day != DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d') AND a.Exp_Lis_Day != '') AND ( c.gnm1 LIKE '%DANPLA BOX%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%(RETURN)%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%PA2%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%PA3%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%PA5%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%KA4%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%KA5%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%D-TYPE%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%PLASTIC BOX%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%A-TYPE%' OR c.gnm1 LIKE '%IRON CARRIER(RETURN)%' )
AND A.rpt_day BETWEEN REPLACE(#{srch2}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{srch3}, '-', '')
AND A.exp_Lis_Day BETWEEN REPLACE(#{srch2}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{srch3}, '-', '')
AND a.rpt_no LIKE CONCAT('%',UPPER(REPLACE(#{srch4},'-','')),'%')
AND a.rpt_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT RPT_NO FROM cusdec830b1selrdy WHERE mg_code like CONCAT('%',UPPER(#{srch5}),'%'))
AND a.exp_sdno IN ('1298118421', '2118180957', '3128103345', '3128109408') GROUP BY a.rpt_no, a.exp_firm, a.buy_firm, b.ran_no, c.sil
HAVING remains_qty > 0
HAVING remains_qty <= 0
) AS EXPORT WHERE 1=1
AND ${srchType1} LIKE CONCAT('%',UPPER(#{srchText1}),'%')
AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(${srchType2}), ' ', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(#{srchType3}), ' ', ''), '(', ''), ')', ''), '%')
AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(${srchType4}), ' ', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(#{srchType5}), ' ', ''), '(', ''), ')', ''), '%')
ORDER BY exp_lis_day LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{startPage};

SELECT rpt_no, docu_path, docu_type, docu_file, docu_org_file, blno, invoice_no, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(upload_dt, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(upload_dt, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(upload_dt, 7, 2)) AS upload_dt FROM platform.file_info WHERE rpt_no = #{srch1} AND docu_type = 'DC'

WITH cte_cusdec AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rpt_no, ran_no, sil ORDER BY rpt_no, ran_no, sil) AS rn FROM platform.cusdec830c1 ) t WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS CNT, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(r.rpt_no, 1, 5), '-', SUBSTRING(r.rpt_no, 6, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(r.rpt_no, 8, 7)) AS rpt_no, r.lan_no, r.sil, r.exp_firm, r.importer, FORMAT(c.qty - COALESCE( SUM(r.used_qty) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.rpt_no, r.lan_no, r.sil ORDER BY r.used_dt, r.reg_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0 ) ,0 ) AS qty, FORMAT(r.used_qty, 0) AS used_qty, FORMAT(c.qty - COALESCE( SUM(r.used_qty) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.rpt_no, r.lan_no, r.sil ORDER BY r.used_dt, r.reg_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ), 0), 0 ) AS remains_qty, FORMAT(c.qty - COALESCE(SUM(r.used_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY r.rpt_no, r.lan_no, r.sil), 0), 0) AS remains_qty, r.used_rsn, DATE_FORMAT(r.used_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS used_dt, r.used_dt AS used_dt2, r.reg_id FROM remains_info r LEFT JOIN cte_cusdec c ON r.rpt_no = c.rpt_no AND c.ran_no = r.lan_no AND c.sil = r.sil WHERE r.rpt_no = #{srch1} AND r.lan_no = #{srch2} AND r.sil = #{srch3} ORDER BY used_dt DESC
SELECT DISTINCT exp_firm FROM platform.cusdec830a1 WHERE exp_sdno IN ('1298118421', '2118180957', '3128103345', '3128109408') AND exp_firm NOT IN ('(주)두원 화성공장')
SELECT DISTINCT buy_firm FROM platform.cusdec830a1 WHERE exp_sdno IN ('1298118421', '2118180957', '3128103345', '3128109408') ORDER BY buy_firm ASC
SELECT DISTINCT Ta_St_isoNm FROM platform.cusdec830a1 WHERE exp_sdno IN ('1298118421', '2118180957', '3128103345', '3128109408') AND Ta_St_isoNm IN ('PR.CHNA', 'INDNSIA', 'INDIA')

SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(c.gnm1, 'RETURNABLE ', '') AS gnm1 FROM platform.cusdec830a1 a LEFT JOIN platform.cusdec830b1 b ON a.rpt_no = b.rpt_no AND a.SN = b.SNA1 LEFT JOIN platform.cusdec830c1 c ON a.rpt_no = c.rpt_no AND a.SN = c.SNA1 AND b.SN = c.SNB1 WHERE exp_sdno IN ('1298118421', '2118180957', '3128103345', '3128109408') AND b.hs IN ('3923100000', '7310290000', '3923900000') AND c.gnm1 IN ( 'DANPLA BOX', 'RETURNABLE PA2 BOX', 'RETURNABLE PA4 BOX', 'RETURNABLE PA5 BOX', 'RETURNABLE KA4 BOX', 'RETURNABLE KA5 BOX', 'RETURNABLE NAP522 BOX', 'D-TYPE', 'BOX (RETURN)', 'PAD (RETURN)', 'PLASTIC BOX', 'A-TYPE', 'PA3', 'IRON CARRIER (RETURN)' ) ORDER BY CASE c.gnm1 WHEN 'DANPLA BOX' THEN 1 WHEN 'RETURNABLE PA2 BOX' THEN 2 WHEN 'RETURNABLE PA4 BOX' THEN 3 WHEN 'RETURNABLE PA5 BOX' THEN 4 WHEN 'RETURNABLE KA4 BOX' THEN 5 WHEN 'RETURNABLE KA5 BOX' THEN 6 WHEN 'RETURNABLE NAP522 BOX' THEN 7 WHEN 'D-TYPE' THEN 8 WHEN 'BOX (RETURN)' THEN 9 WHEN 'PAD (RETURN)' THEN 10 WHEN 'PLASTIC BOX' THEN 11 WHEN 'A-TYPE' THEN 12 WHEN 'PA3' THEN 13 WHEN 'IRON CARRIER (RETURN)' THEN 14 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO remains_info ( rpt_no, exp_firm, importer, used_qty, used_rsn, used_dt, lan_no, sil, del_yn, reg_id ) VALUES ( REPLACE(#{rptNo},'-',''), #{expFirm}, #{importer}, #{usedQty}, #{usedRsn}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{lanNo}, #{sil}, 'N', #{regId})
